title: Eisenhower's meeting with ETs about stopping nuclear proliferation

plain: President Eisenhower is said to have met with extraterrestrials in Palm Springs, California, sometime between 1954 and 1956, and talked with them about stopping the spread of nuclear weapons. The UFO researcher Steven Greer tells Michels he got a series of reports from the French Ministry of Defense showing that the meeting did happen, but he says it 'wasn't the mythology' people usually tell about it. Greer does not quote the reports. He links Allen Dulles, then head of the CIA, and the wealthy Paul Mellon to the story, and if he is right, a US president dealt face to face with beings from elsewhere.
